Allowed origins are configured in `worker\src\index.ts` (lines 19–32), via the `cors()` middleware's `origin` callback function. Currently allowed:

- `http://localhost:4200` (exact match)
- any `*.pages.dev` subdomain
- any `*.workers.dev` subdomain

To add a new custom domain, edit that `origin` function in `worker\src\index.ts` and add a new condition, e.g.:

```ts
origin.endsWith('.your-custom-domain.com') ||
```

or an exact match `origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com'`, inside the `if (...)` block (lines 22–27), so it returns `origin` for the new value instead of `null`.
